# Slasher: Boogeyman
[color=#ac3a0d]"I wonder, if perhaps.. The Boogeyman is able to actually move through shadows.."[/color]
The Boogeyman is a Slasher kit that trades the usual traversal tricks for pure ambush pressure. It has every core Slasher ability except the incorporeal jaunt, and layers on a stealth package built around darkness.
## What's different
- [bold]Shadow invisibility.[/bold] Your sprite fades out in darkness and back in under light. Lurk in the unlit maintenance and you are effectively invisible.
- [bold]No jaunt.[/bold] You do [italic]not[/italic] get the incorporeal form, so you cannot phase through walls or turn invisible on demand. Your stealth comes entirely from staying in the dark. Plan your routes around the lights.
- [bold]Faster on foot, no sprint.[/bold] You cannot sprint, but your walking pace is faster than a normal person's run. You will never sprint, but you never need to.
You still spread [bold]fear[/bold] and gain the same meter, speed and blood-trail benefits as any Slasher.
## Crew Tips
[bold]Light is everything.[/bold] - The Boogeyman is invisible in darkness but fully visible in light. Carry a flashlight, keep the lights on, and repair broken ones. - It cannot phase through walls, so it must use doors and corridors like anyone else - barricades and locked doors actually stop it. - It cannot sprint, but it is faster than your normal walking pace - do not try to simply outwalk it in the open. Break its line of sight and get into the light.
